definitions.explanation: A service or content delivery model where users can access content whenever they want, rather than at scheduled times.

examples.japanese: オンデマンド⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: With on-demand streaming, you can watch movies whenever you want.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧オンデマンド⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This class can be viewed on-demand.

examples.japanese: オンデマンド⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: With print-on-demand, you can print only what you need.

notes:
オンデマンド is a loanword from English "on demand," meaning content or services available whenever requested rather than at fixed times.

COMPOUNDS:
- オンデマンド⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧: on-demand streaming/distribution
- オンデマンド⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: on-demand classes (recorded lectures)
- オンデマンド⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧: print-on-demand
- ビデオ・オン・デマンド (VOD): video on demand

USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly before another noun. Became especially common during the COVID-19 pandemic with the shift to online education.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生放送|なまほうそう}→生放送：08172_namahousou⟧: live broadcast
- ⟦ライブ{配信|はいしん}→ライブ配信：23746_raibuhaishin⟧: live streaming
- ⟦リアルタイム→リアルタイム：11599_riarutaimu⟧: real-time
